name: Ba khia muoi
summary: Ba khía muối is the small salted mangrove crab, eaten with hot rice. The meat is firm and the roe is scant because the crab eats fallen mắm fruit.
origin: Rạch Gốc and the Ngọc Hiển mangrove. The 2024 office address is khóm 8, thị trấn Rạch Gốc, huyện Ngọc Hiển. Later cape pages say xã Đất Mũi.
culture: Người Lao Động on 29 December 2019 says the crabs gather around the tenth lunar month, which is why salting kept them, and that muối ba khía and gác kèo ong were named national intangible heritage. VOV names the same two trades. The next solar date for that lunar month is check on arrival.
taste: The Ngọc Hiển page says the meat is firm and the roe is scant.
howToEat: Eat the salted crab with hot rice. That is the office page.
The same page also names hấp, rang me, and nướng.
One later article describes a mix of sugar, lime, garlic, chili, and rau răm. That mix is one article.
where: Rạch Gốc and the Ngọc Hiển mangrove. No stall is named. A market hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ba khia muoi — salted mangrove crab
seoDescription: Ba khía muối from Rạch Gốc is salted mangrove crab with hot rice. The gathering month is the tenth lunar month. No stall price is printed.
